description: React component for displaying and managing installed outgoing webhooks in Mattermost, including filtering, editing, regenerating tokens, and deleting webhooks.

classes.name: InstalledOutgoingWebhook
classes.description: React component class for rendering an installed outgoing webhook with actions and details.

methods.name: handleRegenToken
methods.description: Handles regeneration of the webhook token when the button is clicked.

methods.name: makeDisplayName
methods.description: Generates display name for the webhook, defaulting to 'A Private Webhook' if none is set.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the webhook details, actions, and filtering logic.
